faqs.question: What are the main product categories of Cosmo?
faqs.answer: Cosmo's main product categories include: 1) Photocouplers (Optocouplers) - transistor output, Darlington output, triac output, and high-speed types; 2) Solid State Relays (SSR) - MOSFET output and triac output types for AC/DC switching; 3) Reed Relays - for switching and sensing applications. These products are widely used in industrial automation, power supplies, automotive, and consumer electronics.

faqs.question: How do I select the right Cosmo photocoupler?
faqs.answer: Selecting the right photocoupler depends on: 1) Output type - transistor, Darlington, or triac; 2) Isolation voltage - typically 2500V to 5000V; 3) Current transfer ratio (CTR); 4) Speed - standard or high-speed; 5) Package type - DIP or SMD.
